verdict.rationale: Digits' API reference documents webhook event delivery, in which Digits sends a JSON request body to a configured webhook endpoint. This is a genuine outbound HTTP callback, but the evidence is a single line in an index summary. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration/subscription mechanism, list of subscribable event types, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
